doc: Official Feishu event signature: sha256(timestamp + nonce + encrypt_key + raw_body) vs X-Lark-Signature. Token may be in JSON or omitted when body is encrypt-shaped. AES decrypt of encrypt is not implemented.

cases.name: encrypt_shaped
cases.note: Official encrypt-shaped POST is {"encrypt":"<ciphertext>"}. Mock does not AES-decrypt; signature is still over raw body.
